events.title: The Iskarn demo is out !
events.summary: Hey everyone ! It's live: the Iskarn demo is free on this page right now. Go build something. What's in it - 5 nights to found your colony and hold the line against whatever crawls out of the dark - The real game, not a slice: build block by block, craft in your workshops, explore the ruins, take control of your hero, keep the menhir burning - English, French, German, Polish and Russian Your colony carries over When dawn breaks after your fifth night, the demo ends but your save doesn't. events.title: Devlog #10
events.summary: Devlog #10 Borrowed Daylight Hey everyone! Two things today. Playtest signups are open, and since you are about to step into this world, it is time I told you what is going on in it. The playtest is open The build is live and it is the real game: the full prologue, colony management, night sieges, exploration, and possession, where you drop into your hero's body and fight it out yourself instead of watching from above. events.title: Devlog #9
events.summary: Devlog #9 Raise the Stone Hey @everyone! Big week. Territory was reborn around a single object, hunger learned to bite back, and stepping into your hero just got a whole lot more obvious. Raise the Stone Claiming land is now a real gesture. You place a menhir, a runic standing stone, and watch it surge up out of the ground to anchor your territory. events.title: Devlog #8
events.summary: Devlog #8 Plant or Perish Hey @everyone! This one is all about food: Iskarn now has real farming, and the seasons actually decide whether your colony eats. From dirt to dinner Mark out a field like you would a stockpile, pick one of four crops, and your Farmers take it from there: they till each tile by hand to turn raw ground into workable soil, sow the seeds, tend the crop, and bring in the harvest. events.title: Devlog #7
events.summary: Devlog #7 Into the Ruins Hey @everyone ! This week was all about one thing: giving you reasons to leave the safety of your village and head out into the unknown. Iskarn now has a living world, full of places to explore, loot, and people to save. A world worth exploring The wilds around your colony are now scattered with abandoned places: hunter's camps, burned inns, ruined mills, flooded mines, fallen citadels and plenty more. events.title: Devlog #6
events.summary: Devlog #6 You are the Hero ! Hey everyone ! Last week I teased a major feature I was rethinking from the ground up. It's here, and honestly, it changes how Iskarn feels to play. The goal with all of this : give the player real impact, pull you into the world, deepen the immersion. Stop being a god moving pieces on a board, become one of the people fighting to keep the colony alive. Be the Hero You're not just the architect floating above the colony anymore. events.title: Devlog #5
events.summary: Devlog #5 The Weight of Steel Hey everyone! Last week brought horde leaders and gate assaults. This week was all about polish: making every single sword swing actually feel like it lands. Hit feel Every connecting blow now has layered punch: - A bright white flash on impact, then the red damage flash settles in - Heavy hits trigger a short camera shake, only for fights happening near you so distant skirmishes don't shake your view - Blood bursts double in intensity on heavy hits - Sword strikes

events.title: Devlog #4
events.summary: Hey everyone ! Combat just got a massive overhaul. Last few weeks turned night assaults from a chore into something tense. Per-citizen stances No more global combat mode. events.title: Devlog #3
events.summary: Hey everyone! This one is big, nights just got teeth. The zombies got a full top-to-bottom rework: how they appear, how they move, how they sound, how they die at dawn. Five faces of the dead Iskarn now has five distinct undead tiers in rotation. A baseline brute, a fragile runner, a bloated tank, a plague-carrier trailing toxic spores, and a rune-marked elite that shows up rarely enough that seeing one actually means something. events.title: Devlog #2
events.summary: Hey @everyone ! Spent the last weeks going deep on the construction system, more shapes, more materials, and smarter rendering. Here's what changed. The catalog now sits at 32 buildable blocks Before : 21. Now : 32. That's 11 brand new building blocks, covering the shapes that were missing for proper medieval architecture : half-blocks, pillars, and a new signature material. events.title: Devlog #1
events.summary: Hey @everyone ! This is my very first devlog for Iskarn. The game has been in development for a while now and is already quite feature-rich, but I've been quietly working on it without sharing much. Time to change that ! Here's what the last two weeks looked like. Performance overhaul, +150% FPS I spent a good chunk of time digging into performance bottlenecks.
